description: s441 fix round 3 (review N2). A handler that awaits a server call calls preventDefault through a closure (`const stop = () => event.preventDefault()`) invoked after the await after that await. The browser has already submitted the form by then (reviewer-executed: defaultPrevented false on the branch, true on main before the handler became async). Round 2 matched only a direct `event.preventDefault()`; the event is now followed by binding through aliases, bracket access and closures, and the build fails closed. (s457 3a: the handler takes the event as the parameter of a `${(event) => { … }}` listener — a compiler-wrapped handler does not bind `event`, SPEC §5.2.)
rationale: §13.2: event control on the handler's event parameter after its first await SHALL be a compile error (E-EVENT-CONTROL-AFTER-AWAIT, §34).
